style.toneOfVoice: <p>Add a touch of elegance and festive charm to your Christmas tree with the Decoris Christmas bauble in Christmas red. You'll love the stunning mix of shiny, matte, glitter and transparent finishes that reflect the enchanting glow of your Christmas lights.</p><p>Give your home that quintessential Christmas warmth and let these Decoris baubles be the highlight of your tree, creating a joyous and inviting atmosphere for all your Christmas celebrations.</p>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Add a touch of elegance to your Christmas tree with the Decoris Christmas bauble in soft grey. Perfect for enhancing your festive decor, this bauble's subtle shade seamlessly integrates with any colour scheme, making your tree look stunning.

Key features:
• Diameter: 7 cm for a perfectly balanced aesthetic
• Made of glass for a classic charm
• Offers a mix of shiny, matte, transparent and glitter finishes for a versatile look
• Equipped with a silver colour metal cap for easy hanging

With its beautiful blend of finishes, this bauble reflects the joy and magic of the Christmas season. Its versatile design allows you to play with different lighting and decoration styles, bringing a festive glow into your home.
